chapter: Leaving the band, Strayhorn and reflections
title: Closing remarks
summary: Crouch thanks Greer and says the tapes are for the Smithsonian; end of cassette four.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well, Mr. Greer, thank you. We're about to the end of this tape, that's about it. I think this is sufficient. I'm going to call them, they may want me to ask you one or two other things. But I can tell, Maestro, I've just about /got it.
But you never did tell me who you made these for.
The Smithsonian Institute, Washington, D. C.
